Subject: Storage on Shared Directories

KiaOra

This is a message to all staff regarding storing information on shared
directories.

ITS staff are often called upon to help departments manage their space
allocation on these drives.  The main issue we see is the amount used is
nearing capacity and causing concern.

If you are sharing these spaces with any students please ensure you
regularly check the validity of information being stored.  We are
finding a lot of movies and other data which do not relate to any work
related purpose.

Files of this nature often take up Gigabytes of storage, may breach
copyright laws and also contravene the Massey Acceptable Computer Use
Policy.

Please contact me if you require any further information;

Thanks & kind regards

Barbie Yerkovich
